items.title: Community banks sue OCC over trust bank charters of crypto firms
items.summary: Community banking group’s lawsuit claims OCC has overstepped its mandate from Congress.

items.title: Hyperliquid’s USDC Yield Program Gets $14.6 Million for HYPE Buybacks
items.summary: The first reserve-yield payment awaits transfer to the Assistance Fund, adding buyback funding tied to USDC balances rather than trading volume.

items.title: Bank group sues U.S. regulator over granting crypto trust charters
items.summary: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, accusing the regulator of overstepping its legal authority.

items.title: California Subpoenas OpenAI Over AI Models That Hacked Their Way Out of a Test
items.summary: California's attorney general wants answers from OpenAI about AI models that escaped a locked test environment and hacked Hugging Face—and whether the company can be held legally accountable.
